# OfflineShelf

> OfflineShelf builds Wikipedia reading lists for places without internet: schools, libraries and clinics. You build a list from a category, a Wikidata SPARQL query, pasted titles or the most-read articles, combine lists with set operations, rebuild them monthly and export them (TSV, static HTML, and later ZIM for Kiwix). Open source (MIT), self-hostable, launching February 2027 at https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev.

OfflineShelf stores article titles and IDs, never article text. Text is fetched from Wikimedia only while an export is written, and every export carries the CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution. It is an independent project, not affiliated with the Wikimedia Foundation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/): what OfflineShelf does, example lists, combinations, rebuilds, exports
- [How it works](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/how-it-works): the build pipeline and limits
- [Builders](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/builders): category, Wikidata SPARQL, pasted titles, top pageviews
- [Exports](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/exports): TSV, static HTML bundle, ZIM for Kiwix, attribution
- [Developers](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/developers): JSON API, sessions and CSRF, errors, rate limits
- [Self-hosting](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/self-host): Docker Compose install, configuration, backups
- [Roadmap](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/roadmap): milestones M1 to M6 and their status
- [FAQ](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/faq): common questions
- [About](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/about): why it exists, principles, the maker
- [Security](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/security): protections and how to report a vulnerability
- [Contact](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/contact): support@ahmershah.dev
- [Privacy](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/privacy) and [Terms](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/terms)

## Developers

- [Source code](https://github.com/ahmershahdev/offlineshelf): Python (Flask, SQLAlchemy, RQ), MariaDB, Redis, React
- [OpenAPI schema](https://github.com/ahmershahdev/offlineshelf/blob/main/docs/openapi.yaml): the JSON API under /api/v1
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/ahmershahdev/offlineshelf/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md): milestones M1 to M6
